mapper.sql: (SELECT audit.create_by FROM sys_audit_log audit WHERE audit.tenant_id = form.tenant_id AND audit.biz_module = 'workflow' AND audit.audit_field = 'formVersion' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(audit.after_json, '$.formId')) = form.form_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(audit.after_json, '$.version')) = CAST(form.version AS CHAR) ORDER BY audit.audit_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS version_creator
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_form_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND form_id = #{formId} AND is_latest = 1 ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM wf_form_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND form_id = #{formId} AND is_latest = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM wf_form_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (form_id = #{identifier} OR form_key = #{identifier}) AND is_latest = 1 ORDER BY form_id LIMIT 2
SELECT form.*, FROM wf_form_definition form WHERE form.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND form.form_id = #{formId} AND form.version = #{version}
SELECT form.*, FROM wf_form_definition form WHERE form.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND form.form_id = #{formId} ORDER BY form.version DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_form_definition SET version_lock = version_lock + 1, form_name = #{formName}, form_key = #{formKey}, checksum = #{checksum} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND is_latest = 1 AND version_lock = #{expectedLock}
UPDATE wf_form_definition SET is_latest = 0 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND is_latest = 1 AND version_lock = #{expectedLock}
mapper.select: SELECT form_id FROM wf_form_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_latest = 1 ORDER BY form_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wf_form_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND form_id = #{formId} AND version = #{version} AND is_latest = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_process_instance instance JOIN wf_process_definition definition ON definition.tenant_id = instance.tenant_id AND definition.definition_id = instance.definition_id WHERE instance.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND definition.form_id = #{formId} AND instance.form_version = #{version})
